verbatim_quotes.text: HPTN 083	Multisite, double blind, double dummy, randomized controlled noninferiority trial	43 sites across Africa, Asia, Latin America, and the United States	Cisgender men who have sex with men and transgender women who have sex with men at-risk for HIV, aged ≥18 years	4570
HPTN 083 enrolled cisgender men and transgender women who have sex with men at-risk for HIV across 43 sites in the United States, Latin America, Africa, and Asia.
HPTN 084	Multisite, double blind, double dummy, randomized controlled superiority trial	20 sites across 7 sub-Saharan African countries	Cisgender women at risk for HIV, 18−45 years old.	3224
HPTN 084 enrolled cisgender women at-risk for HIV across seven sub-Saharan African countries.
